meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: Claude 会按任务动态组建执行、指挥、评审三类角色的智能体团队,用串行、并行、循环等协作模式推进,过程实时可见,各智能体共用同一份数据库记忆,最后汇总成统一结果。
howto.when: 当你需要多个智能体协同完成一项任务,或要为某个场景管理一组智能体时触发;也可以直接点名预设团队,比如技术决策团队、OPC 团队等。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估我们是否该采用微服务架构
say.note: 会看到主持人、架构师、评审员等依次发言并收敛出结论

say.text: 请用OPC团队帮我在AI短视频领域构建一套系统
say.note: 战略、产品架构、自动化工程三个角色串行输出方案

howto.what_en: Claude dynamically assembles an agent team of execution, command, and review roles, runs it in serial, parallel, or loop collaboration, shows the discussion live, has all agents share one database memory, and merges their output into one result.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs several agents working together, or when you want to manage an agent group for a specific scenario; you can also name a preset team such as the tech decision team or OPC team.

say_en.text: Use the tech decision team to evaluate whether we should adopt microservices
say_en.note: You see the moderator, architect, reviewer speak in turn and converge

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for me in the AI short-video space
say_en.note: Strategy, product architecture, and automation agents run in sequence
